title: The Lazy Frog
description: NCERT Class 5 English (Marigold): 'The Lazy Frog'. New words, comprehension, reported speech (basic), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'The Lazy Frog': lazy, pond, complain, effort.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'The Lazy Frog' mean (lazy, pond, complain, effort); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A person who does not like to work is ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: To say you are unhappy about something is to ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: The lazy frog only sat by the pond and complained.
He said that he would help us later.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'The Lazy Frog' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'The Lazy Frog'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The frog in the poem will not even try, because he is ___.
The frog will not even try, because he is so ___.

exemplars: The lazy frog only sat by the pond and complained.
He said that he would help us later.

nodes.title: Reported Speech (basic)
nodes.teach_focus: We can report what someone said: He said, 'I am tired' -> He said that he was tired.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses reported speech (basic) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of reported speech (basic).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Report it: He said, 'I am busy.' -> He said that he ___ busy.
She said, 'I am happy.' -> She said that she ___ happy.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: He said that he was busy.
She said that she would help.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'The Lazy Frog'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'The Lazy Frog': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: Instead of being lazy, we should make an ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: She said, 'I am happy.' -> She said that she ___ happy.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: The lazy frog only sat by the pond and complained.
He said that he would help us later.

items.prompt: To say you are unhappy about something is to ___.
A person who does not like to work is ___.
The frog in the poem will not even try, because he is ___.
The frog will not even try, because he is so ___.
Report it: He said, 'I am busy.' -> He said that he ___ busy.
She said, 'I am happy.' -> She said that she ___ happy.
